name: AnchorCodeToSSP
title: Anchor code to Standard Service Package

text.div:
Anchor code to Standard Service Package

Maps each anchor CPT, HCPCS or MS-DRG code to the SSP it rolls into, or to the sub-variant when one lists the code. Equivalence is wider: the package bundles more than the anchor code.
